skill.summary: Build and execute a content marketing strategy for a solopreneur business. Use when planning what content to create, deciding on content formats and channels, building a content calendar, measuring content performance, or systematizing content production. Covers audience research for content, content pillars, distribution strategy, repurposing workflows, and metrics. Trigger on "content strategy", "content marketing", "what content should I create", "content plan", "content calendar", "content ideas", "content distribution", "grow through content".

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release providing a comprehensive content marketing strategy framework for solopreneurs.

- Covers setting content goals, researching audience needs, and defining content pillars.
- Guides selection of content formats and channels tailored to solopreneurs.
- Includes detailed steps for building a content calendar and batching production.
- Emphasizes content distribution, amplification, and systematic repurposing.
- Offers practical metrics for measuring content performance and business impact.
